prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web booking-flow composition, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: Redesign the AAA Artists booking form as a guided ‘Booking Concierge’. This is composition option B: a running-order lineup builder where the artist slots themselves are the central visual structure, like a precise event schedule, with the active slot editor beside it.
Input image: visual-identity reference only. Carry over the real AAA Artists logo treatment, pure monochrome dark theme, pragmatic system sans typography, square geometry, thin gray rules, restrained underground agency character, and precise spacing. Do not copy the reference page’s accordion layout, header composition, or field arrangement.
Surface structure: minimal site header across the top. Beneath, a slim five-step progress header reading ‘01 ARTISTS 02 EVENT 03 SCHEDULE 04 CONTACT 05 REVIEW’. Large page heading ‘Build your lineup’. Main region uses roughly 60/40 columns. The larger left area is a vertical running order titled ‘YOUR ARTIST LINEUP’: slot ‘01 C-SYSTEMS’ with ‘60 MIN · TIME TBC’; slot ‘02 HELP ME CHOOSE’ with ‘OPENING SLOT · PREFERENCES NEEDED’; and a quiet square ‘+ ADD ANOTHER ARTIST’ row. A thin vertical sequence line and tabular numbering make the lineup read as a deliberate running order, not generic cards. The right area is the editor for selected slot 02, heading ‘Who should fill this slot?’, with two square choices ‘CHOOSE AN ARTIST’ and ‘HELP ME CHOOSE’, then compact preference controls labeled ‘ROLE IN LINEUP’, ‘STYLE / ENERGY’, and ‘BPM RANGE’; helper note ‘You can leave these open and discuss them with us.’ At the bottom, a small persistent strip summarizes ‘TOTAL BUDGET EUR —’, with BACK and one dominant ‘CONTINUE TO EVENT’ button.
Focal moment: the mixed lineup—one confirmed artist and one open recommendation slot—must be immediately understandable and editable.
Style/medium: realistic shippable product UI mockup, not concept art, not a poster.
Color palette: AAA Artists black, off-white, steel gray only. No decorative color.
Typography: strong large sans heading, compact uppercase tracked labels, readable body copy, tabular numbers.
Materials: flat tonal surfaces, one-pixel borders, no shadows, no gradients, no rounded cards.
Constraints: this is an honest future-facing prototype; do not show actual matched recommendations or claim the filter exists. Preserve practical familiar controls. No invented commercial claims, testimonials, prices, photos, emojis, neon, glass, bento dashboard, or extra logos. Render quoted UI text verbatim where possible. No watermark.
